newer_changes_search: Web search (PIB, DFS, press) for 2025-2026 PMJJBY changes: the last confirmed premium revision is 1 June 2022 (Rs 330 to Rs 436); a PIB factsheet of May 2025 still gives Rs 2 lakh cover for Rs 436. A June 2025 press report said the Finance Ministry was considering raising cover to Rs 4 lakh with a higher premium; no notification of that found. The DFS page (progress as on 28.02.2025) matches the content.

findings.note: Correct for joining (18-50, <=50 matches 'age group of 18 to 50 years'). Under the scheme rules, people who joined before 50 can keep renewing up to 55, so an existing 51-55 subscriber is shown NOT_ELIGIBLE. The cited DFS page does not say this, so the rule cannot be widened on this source.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add the PMJJBY rules/FAQ (jansuraksha.gov.in) as a source and mention in content that cover can continue to 55 for those who joined earlier.

findings.note: Amounts (Rs 2 lakh, Rs 436, 1 June-31 May) match quoted facts. The new-subscriber lien period (no cover for non-accidental death in the first 30 days) is omitted; the source does not mention it.
findings.suggestion: Optional, with a source that states it.

findings.note: Possible future change: proposal to raise cover to Rs 4 lakh (2025 press report).
